metadata.conditional_on: facility located within South Coast AQMD jurisdiction

summary: If the coating shop is in South Coast AQMD jurisdiction, installing or operating a coating/paint booth or other equipment that may emit air contaminants generally requires a written Permit to Construct/Operate under Rule 201 before construction/installation/operation. The project facts include a coating or paint operation and 60 gal of flammable solvent, which plausibly involves VOC/air contaminant emissions. No Rule 219 exemption was applied here; exemption/registration pathways require separate fact-specific review. Because the facility county/location is unknown, the controlling air district is not confirmed, so this is a conditional applicability finding rather than a final permit determination.
title: H-AIR-201: SCAQMD Rule 201 permit applicability for coating shop solvent storage / coating operation cannot be finally determined without location, but would be triggered in SCAQMD jurisdiction
